notes.title: Everstead: Origins – Discord Server & Early Access Roadmap now live!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We’re excited to share two updates with you today:[/p][p]🌟 [b]The official Everstead: Origins Discord server is now live![/b]
Join us to chat with fellow players, share feedback, report bugs, and be part of the development. Whether you just want to follow progress or actively shape the game with your input — you’re welcome![/p][p]🌿 [b]The Early Access Roadmap is now available![/b]
See what’s planned for Everstead: Origins across the different development stages. From core village life to politics, trade, and long-term immersion — get a clear view of where the journey is headed.[/p][p]👉 [b]Join the Discord here:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/BcNNUme3"]https://discord.gg/BcNNUme3[/url] [/p][p]Thank you for your support — let’s build something special together![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602569/3c356ac808bd23675684b3123b84e166820d054b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Everstead Origins – A Milestone Reached!
notes.content:
[p]The Steam Next Fest came to an end – and with it, a big decision has been made:[/p][p]We’ve officially reached (and likely passed) the minimum wishlist goal I had personally set to justify moving forward with [b]Early Access[/b]![/p][p]While it’s not quite the explosion I secretly dreamed of, it’s already far more than I expected for such a niche project.
The feedback, wishlists, and overall interest during the demo have been an incredible motivator.
Especially considering that over [b]93%[/b] of players who added it to their wishlist [b]kept it there[/b] – a clear sign that something about the concept resonates.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧭 What’s next?[/h3][p]Over the coming weeks, the project will transition into focused [b]Early Access development[/b].
The [b]entire settler system[/b] is being rebuilt from the ground up to support deeper simulation, smarter behavior, and a more dynamic world.[/p][p]A [b]comprehensive Early Access roadmap[/b] is currently in the works and will be published [b]a few weeks before release[/b].
It will give you a transparent look at what’s planned, what’s prioritized, and what to expect on day one – and beyond.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 Join the Discord – and help shape what comes next[/h3][p]A new [b]Beaver Fever Games Discord server[/b] will go live in the coming days, built around [i]Everstead Origins[/i] and all future titles.
It will be a place to:[/p][list][*][p]Stay up to date with development[/p][/*][*][p]Share ideas and feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Ask questions and help others[/p][/*][*][p]Chat about the universe and its lore[/p][/*][*][p]...or just hang out and watch things unfold[/p][/*][/list][p]I’ll be listening closely – but always with the intent to protect the [b]core vision[/b] of the game.
That means feedback and criticism are genuinely welcome – and many ideas might be adopted, as long as they [b]align with the spirit of Everstead[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for being part of this weird little experiment.
And now... [b]let’s build something special.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3 last improvements before the bigger Update
notes.content:
[h3] [b]General Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Updated Ingame Descriptions[/b]
All in-game texts have been revised to reflect the decision to release [i]Everstead: Origins[/i] as an [b]Early Access title[/b] following the Steam Next Fest feedback and number of wishlists.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Passive Gameplay Disclaimer[/b]
A new [b]confirmation checkbox[/b] makes it clear from the start: [i]Everstead[/i] is a [b]passive village simulation[/b]. Too many players missed this core concept — now it’s unmistakably stated.[/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Settler Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Follow Function[/b]
You can now [b]follow individual settlers[/b] via their detail panel — a great way to watch daily life, behavior, and personality up close.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smarter Builders[/b]
Builders now [b]fetch materials on their own[/b], reducing early-game idle time and creating a smoother simulation flow.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2 – Small Improvements Before the Big Leap
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Here’s a small but helpful update based on your feedback:[/p][list][*][p] [b]Hammering sounds now come with subtle variations[/b] – no more identical clangs![/p][/*][*][p] [b]Added a Reset Camera button[/b] to quickly refocus on your camp.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Improved dropdown menu visuals[/b] for better readability and interaction.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]New controls menu[/b]: You can now check all inputs at any time.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]This will likely be the [b]last patch during the Steam Next Fest[/b] – and for good reason:[/p][p]The past two months have been an intense ride, and I’ll be taking [b]a short creative break[/b] to recharge a bit. After that, I’ll fully commit to rebuilding the core settler system — making the game smarter, more reactive, and more immersive than ever before.[/p][p][/p][p]
[b] Beaver Fever Games[/b][/p]

notes.title: Everstead Origins – What’s Next?
notes.content:
[p][b]Short-Term Fixes & Long-Term Vision[/b][/p][p]First of all, thank you to everyone who played the early tech demo and shared their feedback — your input is already helping shape the future of [i]Everstead Origins[/i]![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Coming in the next few days:[/h3][p]We’re currently working on a handful of [b]small but impactful improvements[/b] based directly on your feedback:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]monitor selection setting[/b] to improve multi-display compatibility[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved dropdown menus[/b] that are easier to read and interact with[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]camera reset function[/b] to quickly refocus on the camp[/p][/*][*][p]An [b]auto-follow feature[/b] for settlers — so you can track their daily routines[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]quick-start control guide[/b] displayed at the beginning (and accessible anytime)[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i](Optional key remapping will be added later — it's on the roadmap!)[/i][/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3]Rebuilding the settler system (mid/long-term goal):[/h3][p]We’ve decided to take a short step back in order to take a [b]giant leap forward[/b]:
In the coming weeks, the [b]entire settler logic system[/b] will be rebuilt from the ground up.[/p][p]This is [b]not a random change[/b] — it's a necessary step to ensure the long-term quality of the simulation.
During internal testing and with your early feedback, it became clear that the current system causes too many inconsistencies when managing [b]free time[/b], [b]tasks[/b], and [b]transitions between behaviors[/b].[/p][p]To truly bring the world of [i]Everstead Origins[/i] to life, this refactor is essential.[/p][p]The new system will:[/p][list][*][p]Give every settler [b]full autonomy[/b] over their behavior, needs, jobs, and free time[/p][/*][*][p]Eliminate centralized commands from buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Enable [b]smarter, self-managing AI routines[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Create a much [b]cleaner and more scalable foundation[/b] for future features[/p][/*][/list][p]In short: the simulation will feel [b]more natural, immersive, and alive[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p]We’ll continue pushing out small patches in the meantime to improve stability and usability.
Thanks for your patience — and stay tuned as [i]Everstead Origins[/i] evolves step by step![/p][p][/p][p]— [i]Beaver Fever Games[/i][/p]
